judgement.summary: A single fermentation-arc concept for a Leeds chef's portfolio: twelve scroll sections drawn from her real kitchen (jar wall, koji cupboard, ferment log, Brine zine, Sunday Pot), with WebGL set pieces, a dark amber palette, and documented phone/reduced-motion/no-3D fallbacks. Its greatest weakness is that the 3D is a sequence of unrelated scenes whose information survives intact without it, and the first reply asserted the inflated readings of the waste figure and the Fjaerland stage before the person corrected them.

traps.evidence: First reply: "through Leeds Kitchen College, Brassica, the Fjaerland Fermentation Lab in Norway, Corn Exchange, to Saltmarsh" — a career step among employers, no stage qualification.
First reply: "The numbers — 14kg of food waste down to 5kg a week, supplier list from 31 to 12" — her current figures, no "we", no method.
No Head Chef date appears in the first reply; the timeline simply runs "Corn Exchange, to Saltmarsh".
First reply: "The four issues (Olu's drawings) presented as something you leaf through" — planned in without permission; Priya credited but ownership unaddressed.

final.question: scrolling down the site mirrors fermentation — raw and discarded at the top, held and watched in the middle, becoming something at the bottom

swap.reason: The spine is made of things only this person has — the jar wall, the koji cupboard, the ferment log, the Brine zine, Sunday Pot — not generic chef material.

backdrop.reason: The plan itself says every WebGL moment has a non-3D equivalent carrying "same information, lighter render", so deleting the 3D costs only presentation.

depth.reason: The declared raw-held-becoming arc is not borne out by the order: origins sit at section 8 after the dishes, and the numbers, koji room, zine and teaching beats could be reshuffled without loss.

clipart.reason: There is no single central object — hero jars, a wall, a cupboard door, a logbook, an emptying vessel, an SVG route and a fanned zine are separate scenes.

honesty.reason: The final plan states the stage, the "we" waste figure with its method and exclusions, the September 2022 title, and holds Olu's art pending permission.

thirty_seconds.reason: The hero gives name, role and one line, but proof and all three contact doors sit at the very bottom and the final plan carries no persistent nav.

plain_reader.reason: "Head Chef, Saltmarsh" plus one line on fermentation and whole-vegetable cooking is plain to an outsider and makes no claim a kitchen professional would wince at.
